gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma Multiforme of Brain

New contrast-enhancing lesion or lesions showing increased enhancement (\>25%increase) in a patient with a historical diagnosis of glioblastoma (histologic or molecular proof) on standard MRI after completion of treatment

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a non-therapeutic trial in that imaging will not be used to direct treatment decisions.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: To perform metabolic phenotyping of treatment naïve and recurrent GBM by multitracer \[18F\]Fluciclovine and 18F-FDG PET.

role_evidence.quote: Fluciclovine F18: To perform metabolic phenotyping of treatment naïve and recurrent GBM by multitracer \[18F\]Fluciclovine and 18F-FDG PET.
Subsequently, the subjects will undergo injection of up to 10 mCi of 18F-FDG followed by a static 20-minute scan approximately 60 minutes post injection

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Tumour gene expression of glutamine/glutamate, glucose and lactate metabolism (RNA-seq, proteomics)

source_quote.quote: Correlation of PET uptake values (SUV) and kinetic parameters (volume of distribution) with gene expression of glutamine and glucose metabolism.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 non-therapeutic imaging study. Both PET tracers are diagnostic agents (radiopharmaceutical flag reserved for therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals). 18F-FDG is not a registered intervention but every subject receives it per protocol, so listed (R9). No candidate: S6 fails with no_pharmacological_candidate. cns5 'historical' because conditions use 'Glioblastoma Multiforme of Brain'. Population includes new masses radiologically consistent with GBM (not yet histologically confirmed) and recurrent GBM; coded gbm_only. MRS glutamate/lactate are imaging markers, not listed.
